title: The book I'm going to read
goal: Describe what is going to happen with -jAk and -mAjAk before a noun.

intro.text: `-jAk`, the future, also stands before a noun: *geljek myhmanlar* (the guests who are coming), *okajak kitabym* (the book I'm going to read). Negative: *gelmejek adam* (someone who won't come). Alone it takes endings, with k → g: *aýtjagym* (what I'm going to say).

exercises.question: How do you say **the book I'm going to read**?

exercises.explain: Before a consonant the t stays: *gitjek*, as in the future.

exercises.gloss: what I'm going to say (as an object)

exercises.en: The place we're going to isn't far.

reject.why: *Giden ýerimiz* is the place we went to. Not yet gone: *gitjek*.

exercises.explain: *git-* + *-jek* before the noun, with **our** on it: *gitjek ýerimiz*.

accept: The guests who are coming are from Mary.
The guests who will come are from Mary.
The guests who are going to come are from Mary.
The guests coming are from Mary.

exercises.prompt: I've forgotten what I was going to say.

reject.why: *Aýdanymy* is **what I said**. Not said yet: *aýtjagymy*.
It is the object of *ýatdan çykardym*: *aýtjagymy*.

exercises.explain: *aýtjagym* (what I'm going to say) + the accusative: *aýtjagymy ýatdan çykardym*.

exercises.question: *Geljek ýyl* (next year) is literally…
options: the year that is to come

why.2: That would need a possessive: *gelen ýylym*.

exercises.explain: *geljek*: that will come. *Geljek ýyl*, *geljek hepde*: the year, the week to come.

exercises.prompt: Bu meniň okajak kitabym, ony entek açmadym.
accept: This is the book I am going to read; I have not opened it yet.
This is the book I will read; I have not opened it yet.
This is the book I am going to read, but I have not opened it yet.

exercises.prompt: The guests who are coming tomorrow are from Dashoguz.

exercises.question: Which is **someone who won't come**?

why.2: *Gelmeýän biri* is **someone who doesn't come, isn't coming**.

exercises.explain: The negative of `-jAk` before a noun: *gel-* + *-me-* + *-jek*.

exercises.prompt: Is there anyone who won't come to the wedding?

reject.why: *Gelmedik* is **who didn't come**. It hasn't happened yet: *gelmejek*.

exercises.explain: *toýa gelmejek biri* (someone who won't come to the wedding) + *barmy?*

accept: The photos I am going to show you are very beautiful.
The pictures I am going to show you are very beautiful.
The [photos|pictures] I will show you are very [beautiful|pretty|nice].
The [photos|pictures] I am going to show you are very [pretty|nice].

exercises.prompt: The topic of the film we're going to watch next week is history.
accept: Geljek hepde görjek filmimiziň mowzugy taryh.
Biziň geljek hepde görjek filmimiziň mowzugy taryh.

reject.answer: Geljek hepde gören filmimiziň mowzugy taryh.

exercises.explain: *geljek hepde görjek filmimiz* (the film we'll watch next week) + genitive *-iň*, and *mowzuk* + *-y*: *mowzugy*.
